ruling.semanticRuling: 勘破 names carrying an examination through until the person, claim, or situation is exposed or decisively known. Active constructions present someone as seeing through another; 被 constructions present someone as being exposed. Those voice and argument changes concern one event and do not establish separate lexical things.
ruling.semanticLimits: Do not make 勘破 a guarantee of enlightenment or final truth. The records use it both for Zhaozhou's announced examination of the old woman and for later speakers saying that a person or presentation has been exposed; appraisal of whether a claimed examination succeeded belongs to each complete case.

ruling.actorGate: The person who says 勘破 owns the turn; the examined or exposed person is context. Passive 被 constructions do not transfer utterership to their grammatical patient. Later quoters remain later quoters.
